a.lede: The FBI is warning members of the ShinyHunters extortion group to turn themselves in after Dutch police arrested a man the bureau described as one of the group's alleged leaders. [...]
a.title: FBI tells ShinyHunters members to turn themselves in after recent arrest

b.lede: Dutch police said the hacker, arrested for being part of the ShinyHunters cybercriminal gang, had plans to organize the murder of two people on his laptop.
b.title: Dutch police arrest ShinyHunters hacker accused of planning two murders
